23. In his cross examination he stated that after conclusion of hearing of Dispute Case No. 129 of 2003 the resulted of the Judgment and Order was supplied to Abul Kalam Azad and handed over Khatian to him on 02-7-2008. He also admitted that due to disposal of the Dispute Case said Abul Kalam Azad has become inimical with the office. 

 39. DW I, Md. Hasnat Howlader who is one of the accused and deposed in the Court and stated that on 6-7-2008 he went to the Uzirpur Settlement Office to bring his Khatian No. 359 and he stated that which he was behind the Jahangir at that time he saw Azad (PW 8) was talking with accused Md Nurul Islam Jamaddar regarding his land and accused Md Nurul Islam Jamaddar demanded Taka 3,000 as bribe from him for the needful for the land of Abul Kalam Azad then Professor Azad give Taka 3,000 to accused Nurul Islam then those money was handed over to accused Jahangir Alam by accused Nurul Islam and thereafter 2/3 minute the raiding party men entered into the room and then accused Jahangir Alam put the said money in his pocket. And then and there the man of ACC caught red handed of Jahangir Alam and that money of 6 piece of notes each price of Taka 500 brought by the Jahangir Alam and he along with Jahangir and Nurul Islam were arrested by the raiding party man and taking to the Office of ACC.
